references.title: Enciclopedia dell'Italiano — Passato remoto
references.note: Eva Wiberg. Used to check: -ei/-etti alternatives (vendei o vendetti); narrative (foreground) function; regional Italian largely mirrors dialect usage; strong preference for the passato remoto in Sicilian, Calabrian and Salentine dialect areas.

references.title: Enciclopedia dell'Italiano — Passato prossimo
references.note: Eva Wiberg. Used to check: Aoristic passato prossimo spreading from the North, except in Tuscany; in the South the passato remoto is used where the standard would have the passato prossimo.

references.title: Enciclopedia dell'Italiano — Participio
references.note: Verner Egerland. Used to check: Agreement with a preceding direct-object clitic, especially 3rd person; less regular with 1st/2nd person (ci hanno visti / visto); agreement with relative che no longer standard (literary, antiquated, dialectal); participio assoluto. The article does not discuss ne.

references.title: Enciclopedia dell'Italiano — Periodo ipotetico
references.note: Michele Prandi. Used to check: Three standard types (reality, possibility, unreality); substandard double imperfetto, attested in Dante, Machiavelli, Manzoni; conditional in the protasis non-standard ('doppio condizionale').

references.title: Enciclopedia dell'Italiano — Congiuntivo
references.note: Michele Prandi. Used to check: Indicativo for congiuntivo in completive clauses = lower register, same meaning; in restrictive relatives the mood choice changes the meaning.
